body.message:
Good Morning,

We would like to inform you that we have received a request from the owner to arrange a brief viewing of the apartment for bank valuation purposes, which is required as part of the property’s renewal process.

We kindly request your cooperation in allowing access to the valuation team. The visit will be brief and can be arranged at either of the following times:

• Today between 5:00 PM and 6:00 PM
• Wednesday between 11:00 AM and 12:00 PM

Could you please let us know which date and time would be more convenient for you? Once confirmed, we will coordinate with the concerned team accordingly.

We sincerely appreciate your understanding and cooperation, and apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
